Key statistic box

Source: R/crukKeyStatBox.R
crukKeyStatBox.Rd

A bordered box containing a key statement and, optionally, an image. The image sits to the left of the statement when there is room, and above it otherwise. The image and the statement are both aligned to the top of the box.

Usage

crukKeyStatBox(
  statement,
  image = "shinyCRUK/images/CI-logo-no-text.svg",
  showImage = TRUE,
  boxColour = "#bbc7d9"
)

Arguments

statement

A single character string, or a Shiny output such as shiny::textOutput() or shiny::uiOutput().

image

Optional. The src of the image to show: either a file name in the app's www folder, e.g. "magnifying-glass.svg", or a path served by a registered resource path. Displayed 140px wide, with its aspect ratio kept and a maximum height of 140px, aligned to the top left. Defaults to the Cancer Research UK logo mark shipped with this package. NULL means no image.

showImage

TRUE (the default) to show image, FALSE to hide it.

boxColour

Colour of the box border, as a hex code ("#RRGGBB" or "#RGB", case-insensitive; the leading # is required). Defaults to "#bbc7d9" (CRUK grey). A warning is given if the colour is not one of the CRUK brand colours: black #000000; cyan #009CEE, #BCE4FA, #5BC5F2; magenta #E60078, #E60079, #F8C9DF, #F088B6; navy #00007E, #CCCCE6, #6666B2; grey #BBC7D9, #C6C6C6, #878787.

Value

A htmltools::tag object.

Examples

crukKeyStatBox("Nearly 1 in 2 of us will get cancer in our lifetimes.")
#> <div class="cruk-key-stat-box">
#>   <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__box" style="--cruk-key-stat-box-colour: #BBC7D9;">
#>     <img src="shinyCRUK/images/CI-logo-no-text.svg" alt="" class="cruk-key-stat-box__image"/>
#>     <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__statement">Nearly 1 in 2 of us will get cancer in our lifetimes.</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
crukKeyStatBox("A statement", image = "magnifying-glass.svg")
#> <div class="cruk-key-stat-box">
#>   <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__box" style="--cruk-key-stat-box-colour: #BBC7D9;">
#>     <img src="magnifying-glass.svg" alt="" class="cruk-key-stat-box__image"/>
#>     <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__statement">A statement</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
crukKeyStatBox("No image here", showImage = FALSE)
#> <div class="cruk-key-stat-box">
#>   <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__box" style="--cruk-key-stat-box-colour: #BBC7D9;">
#>     <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__statement">No image here</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
crukKeyStatBox("A navy box", boxColour = "#00007e")
#> <div class="cruk-key-stat-box">
#>   <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__box" style="--cruk-key-stat-box-colour: #00007E;">
#>     <img src="shinyCRUK/images/CI-logo-no-text.svg" alt="" class="cruk-key-stat-box__image"/>
#>     <div class="cruk-key-stat-box__statement">A navy box</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
